\]

\[

\]

Equation (2) is an elliptic curve; we shall now bound the possible values

### 2.  Bounding the size of \(a\)

From \(a=m^{2}-n^{2}=(m-n)(m+n)\) we have two cases.

Then \(m>n\ge0\).  Since \(m-n\ge1\),

\[
m+n=\frac{a}{\,m-n\,}\le a .

\[
